summary: Today presents a mixed legal and market environment driven by a landmark Supreme Court ruling on PMLA adjudications alongside strong consumer sector metrics showing 13.1% urban FMCG growth. Counsel should also note expanding commercial credit availability and new international retail distribution partnerships.

bullets.text: The Supreme Court ruled that final PMLA property attachments require a judicial member, while single non-judicial members can only issue show-cause notices.
Urban India recorded 13.1% FMCG growth while traditional trade retained an 80% market share, according to a Worldpanel report.
A new industry report shows India's micro business credit market has expanded to Rs 29.6 lakh crore.
WhatsApp is rolling out in-app travel eSIM purchases, partnering with telecom operators including Reliance Jio and Verizon.
French beauty brand Sisley Paris partnered with Global SS Beauty Brands to re-enter India, targeting a top-10 global market rank in 10 years.
